question: Should CLI-generated WebVNC credentials reuse the existing one-use Durable Object handoff store while https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/969 remains open?
rationale: The patch removes credentials from browser URLs, but it routes CLI credentials into the same plaintext handoff storage model that already has an open security issue, so automation should not infer the intended security boundary.

options.title: Accept Existing Handoff Store
options.body: Merge this URL-fragment hardening after the changelog cleanup and keep encrypted or non-plaintext handoff storage tracked separately.

options.title: Block On Storage Redesign
options.body: Require this PR to avoid plaintext Durable Object credential records before expanding the handoff path to CLI-generated credentials.

recommendation.title: Accept Existing Handoff Store
recommendation.body: Merge this URL-fragment hardening after the changelog cleanup and keep encrypted or non-plaintext handoff storage tracked separately.
